'''Foster''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the Mod. This Effect can only be applied to parasites.

Parasites with this effect will have their [[Adaptation System|Adaptation]] to damage sources increased over time once they have adapted to a damage source.  Parasites that cannot adapt are not affected by this effect.
